name: portfolio-lint-monorepo
description: Portfolio AI-Readiness Framework: measure whether your project portfolio data can support AI forecasting and agent-driven execution.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @portfolio-lint/core && npm run build -w portfolio-lint

scripts.scan:erp: node packages/cli/dist/bin.js scan --source csv --file examples/erp-portfolio.csv --now 2026-08-24T00:00:00Z --name "Aurora ERP"
